initiative.title: Claim Recovery and Work Identity Correction
initiative.summary: Complete owner-bound claim recovery transactions and repair merge-damaged work identity authority before the next Runtime release.

taskset.display_name: Claim Recovery and Work Identity Correction
taskset.summary: Make recovery durable and collision-safe, restore exact ledger and taskset authority, and re-key the lost V080 Scribe and Compound work without rewriting history.

tasks.title: Complete durable owner-bound claim recovery transactions
tasks.goal: Finish the missing TASK-AR-659 rotation path and make every recovery mutation independently auditable after stdout, pane events, or process state are gone.
tasks.scope: Add canonical work-identity binding, immutable receipt-first recovery WAL semantics, strict durability outcomes, and in-place expired-claim owner rotation with worker lineage and verifier exclusion.
acceptance: New and adopted claims bind the canonical task task_uid and unit work_uid; heartbeat, renew, release, and rotate reject identity drift.
Adopt, terminalize, activate-store, and rotate publish an immutable receipt before subject mutation and retain exact semantic and raw before/after digests plus Owner attribution.
Receipt failure leaves the subject byte-identical, post-write uncertainty is non-retry-safe, and pane-event loss cannot erase recovery authority.
Rotate changes one provably expired active claim in place, preserves task/unit/scope/branch authority, advances one revision, and never creates, deletes, completes, or releases a claim.
Old workers immediately lose mutation authority and current plus prior worker lineage is barred from independent release verification.
Old/new agent-instance truth, projections, handoff/log continuity, template parity, and host lock remain consistent.

units.title: Bind claim work identity and add receipt-first recovery WAL
units.context: TASK-AR-659 records recovery digests only on stdout, activate-store can succeed after losing its only audit event, strict fsync outcomes are hidden, and claim files are bound only to reusable display IDs.
units.scope: Local filesystem claim authority only. Recovery receipts are machine authority; Markdown reviews remain explanation. Preserve the existing scope_binding wire format.
steps: RED identity-drift, missing/tampered receipt, receipt-sink, strict-fsync, activation crash-gap, pane-event-loss, and post-commit-indeterminate cases.
Resolve canonical task_uid and unit work_uid into a separate immutable work-identity binding and validate it on every claim mutation.
Add one canonical JSON encoder, strict receipt publication outcomes, schema, immutable receipt builder, validator, and check command.
Publish receipt-first for adopt, terminalize, and activate-store using a claim-store under-lock precommit transition callback.
Make pane events derived notifications and preserve receipt bindings through heartbeat and renew.
Mirror, inventory, regenerate the host lock, and prove no grandfather receipt is synthesized for the 2026-08-03 manual recovery.
acceptance: A display-ID collision or changed task/unit UUID blocks claim use.
Exact persisted receipt and predicted subject bytes reproduce their recorded hashes.
Receipt publication failure occurs before subject mutation.
A subject failure leaves only a prepared receipt and cannot be reported committed.
Already initialized activation creates no false recovery receipt or event.

PYTHONPATH=src python -m pytest tests/test_template_mirror_gate.py tests/test_regen_host_lock_if_needed.py tests/test_template_smoke.py -q
units.handoff: Attach RED commits, receipt state matrix, exact digest proof, crash/failure matrix, work-identity drift negatives, template parity, managed-lock proof, W4a, and independent W4b.
units.stop_condition: Stop before rotation, claim release/acceptance/completion, external CI, consumer mutation, credential access, push, tag, publish, or deploy.

units.title: Implement owner-attributed in-place expired-claim rotation
units.context: TASK-AR-659 promised rotation but shipped only adopt, terminalize, and activate-store. Autofolio demonstrates the recovery need, but its manual rotation omitted prior-owner lineage, old-instance termination, and prior-worker verifier exclusion.
units.scope: In-place recovery of one adopted, provably expired active worker/orchestrator claim. Owner identity is durable attribution, not cryptographic authentication.
steps: RED expired success, legacy-adopt sequence, live/terminal/overlay/indeterminate refusals, every CAS dimension, task UID replacement, races, receipt failure, and history-cap behavior.
Require expected raw digest, revision, old agent/callsite, scope digest, work-identity digest, initialized store snapshot, Owner identity, and reason.
Atomically rotate identity and complete lease tuple while preserving task, unit, taskset, scope, branch, role, team, model, progress, and claimed_at.
Append bounded worker lineage, terminate the old instance, spawn the new instance, refresh projection/handoff/log, and emit a receipt-bound rotation notification.
Reject current or prior worker identities as the release verifier and prove old heartbeat fails while new heartbeat succeeds.
Mirror documentation and implementation, regenerate the host lock, then obtain independent W4b.
acceptance: Exactly one concurrent beat/rotate or rotate/rotate mutation commits.
No successful rotation changes claim path or claim_id or creates/deletes a claim.
Legacy claims must be adopted before rotation and ambiguous canonical work identity always refuses.
Old instance termination and new instance spawn are durable and projections match the new revision.
Every prior worker is excluded from independent release verification.

tasks.goal: Repair the first-parent merge loss without overwriting canonical 653/654, and make the same ledger, taskset, or claim-identity corruption fail closed in owner governance.
tasks.scope: Add inverse exact reservation validation, explicit taskset membership validation, immutable collision mapping, exact six-row ledger restoration, V080 membership correction, and stale Host Required Merge Gates closeout reconciliation.
acceptance: Every canonical task has one exact fulfilled reservation row and every fulfilled row resolves to the same task path and task_uid.
The ledger restores exactly 652 and 655-659 while the colliding old 653/654 reservations are never reintroduced as canonical rows.
Every taskset with explicit membership is exact in both directions and V080 no longer aliases the unrelated canonical 653/654 tasks.
An immutable recovery map binds lost task/unit UUIDs and historical claim digests to successor Tasks 662/663 without rewriting terminal artifacts.
New claims carry canonical work UUID binding and a reused display ID cannot appropriate historical claim authority.
The current Host Required Merge Gates task metadata is reconciled only from its own released claim and approved W4b evidence.

units.title: Repair work identity authority and prevent first-parent ledger loss
units.context: Merge 2db74f8f kept first-parent TASK-AR-653/654 and ledger bytes while losing six non-conflicting rows and the V080 Scribe/Compound task records. Existing gates validate ledger-to-task only and do not enforce registry membership in owner governance.
units.scope: Implement gates and immutable recovery mapping in the worker. Shared task, unit, reservation-ledger, registry, pointer, and generated-view reconciliation remains orchestrator-owned W5 work.
steps: RED missing/dangling/mismatched task reservation, wrong V080 membership, omitted 659, claim display-ID reuse, and tampered collision map.
Add task-to-ledger inverse exact linkage and taskset registry bidirectional membership validation.
Validate a bounded immutable work-identity recovery registry with old/new UUID, claim path/digest, evidence, and commit ancestry bindings.
Make claim create/adopt and later mutations consume exact canonical work identity and refuse unresolved collision history.
Under orchestrator authority restore exactly six reservation rows, correct V080 membership, and reconcile Host Gates metadata from non-colliding evidence.
Refresh generated views, run owner governance, and obtain independent W4b.
acceptance: The pre-fix repository reproduces both wrong-membership and missing-reservation REDs.
No invalid JSON merge strategy or display-ID overwrite is used.
Historical claim files remain byte-identical.
Owner governance transitively blocks every new identity finding.
Template gates remain usable with an absent or empty recovery registry.
